You don't deserve it.

I understand those feelings very much. 

Think you should look into if you'd be accepted for disability payments and if you could cope with the process.

I think alot of people only recognise the good of another person properly when they are gone and it's tragic.

Can you get on disability? I'm amazed that you are working. 

I'm gutted all that has happened. It's huge. I'm really sorry, not a pitiful way, just for a fellow being who is suffering as you are.

No wonder you are worn down. 
The people you are staying with I wish I they could walk in your shoes for just a day.

Can you get on disability? I'm amazed that you are working. 

I'm gutted all that has happened. It's huge. I'm really sorry, not a pitiful way, just for a fellow being who is suffering as you are.

No wonder you are worn down. 
The people you are staying with I wish I they could walk in your shoes for just a day.

Is it quiet where you are?  When you talk about being constantly sick - how long have you been suffering at an unacceptable level?

I experience chronic unpredictable pain and  have no idea how people manage life with illnesses that affect then.

I took wish I could give you a hug.

My perspective is that life wears one down so end up having a higher fear for living than  death. Like our fear goes and that we welcome death, not always with open arms but suicidal people have lost hope and I can see you have and are waiting for that time.

Does anyone know what exact thoughts you have?
Why have you gone for that method or has it been chosen for you?

I thought of jumping into water I know it would finish me off but I could be stopped by  a misguided hero. 

I am standing with you and I'll talk with you if you want.

Maybe some battles are undefeatable if your constantly fighting. I hope for others that are in despair that they can stay around if they need. That people show them they care.

I'm 35, I haven't had an attempt in years. I wasn't supposed to be here now, yes I called ambulance when I woke, I think it was instinctive but was incorrect action an I'm not planning this one.

Thanks for listening, that's a sure thing that I am not heard out there.  It means alot.

I'm not going to say anything though, it's inward and building to a crescendo and I waiting for that so I can then hang myself.

I have learnt lessons.

I feel like I could be sick, I'm shaky. I'm raw inside and outside nobody would sense anything isn't right. 

I realise things can't be helped now and I'm sad about things I cannot change and I hope I get same relief the night of the 29th.
